content.simple_explanation: To learn A Peek Beyond the Point, first understand the main idea, then identify supporting evidence/examples or steps, and finally apply the idea.
key_points: 3 A PEEK BEYOND THE POINT 3.1 The Need for Smaller Units Sonu’s mother was fixing a toy.
She brought another screw from the box and was able to fix the toy.
But when he observed them closely, he saw they were of slightly different lengths.
Sonu was fascinated by how such a small difference in lengths could matter so much.
He was also curious to know how little the difference was because the screws looked nearly the same.
What is the meaning of 2 7 cm (the length of the first screw)?
